x: We also had two races in the 440 yards Senior, and Bob Wolton won the first race, with "Jock" Cameron taking the second race. Wolton beat both Bob Taylor and Ian Badiali and is showing great improvement this season.

The 440 yds. saw Arthur Wint "strolling" round the track to record 50.4 secs and "Jock" Cameron ran well to gain 2nd place for us. In the final event, the 1 mile medley relay, our team of Bob Taylor, Bartlett, Holtum and Bob Wolton finished 3rd behind the Poly. and Achilles in 3 mins. 35 secs.

The following evening, at Motspur Park, we fielded a team in a 1 mile medley relay and Ian Badiali gave us the lead over the half-mile stage, then Ian Forrester and Dicky Bartlett did the two 220's with "Jock" Cameron running the quarter, and we eventually finished 3rd.
"Jock" Cameron was 2nd in 51.2 secs., and Jack Brown won the 880, with Frank Wright in 2nd place in 1 min. 59.4 secs. Peter Bagnall was 2nd to Nankeville in a 4 mins. 15 secs 1 mile. and Chas.

John Bromley won the 880 yds., and also finished 2nd in the 2 miles and so had a busy evening, and Bill Lucas was 4th in the latter event, with Len Bishop 2nd in the 880. Bob Wolton won the 440 yds., with "Jock" Cameron in 2nd place, and Percy Luxon won both the High and Long Jumps.

Ron Holtum was 4th in the 100 yds. final, and won a Lamp and Shade, while "Jock" Cameron won the 440 yds. final, and so got himself a fine canvass Holdall, and we are asking the promoters to put up a Track Suit for next year's race !

The 4 x 440 yds. saw only six teams competing and so this event was run as a final and we finished 5th, and at least our team of Bob Wolton, Jim Heathfield, Bob Taylor and " Jock " Cameron had the satisfaction of beating the Midland champions, Coventry Godiva H.
Our team of Ian Badiali, Ron Morrell, Bob Wolton and " Jock " Cameron also won the 1 mile scratch relay in the good time of 3 mins. 36.8 secs.
